issues.where: whole lit hemisphere, left and centre (crops D, G, N, O, S)
issues.what: the cloud texture breaks down into blocky, smeared rectangular chunks with heavy directional streaking; the texture has been magnified far past its resolution and reads as stretched, low-resolution pixels rather than cloud
issues.fix: use a much higher-resolution or procedural cloud map for close views, or switch levels of detail by distance, and remove the directional smear filter

issues.where: lower band of the globe, bottom left to bottom centre (crops D, T, U, H)
issues.what: the surface is stretched into parallel horizontal streaks, like a texture smeared along one axis or a motion blur baked into the frame; no shape holds at native size
issues.fix: fix the UV mapping or projection at this latitude and drop any motion blur from a still judged frame

issues.where: dark side and terminator, centre right (crops A, E, H, P, Q)
issues.what: the night side is a muddy grey-green, crusty noise that looks like a sharpening or upscaling artefact rather than cloud tops; it clashes with the gold palette of the day side
issues.fix: regenerate the night-side detail with the same cloud material, darkened smoothly, and cut the sharpening

issues.what: the limb is a soft, doubled band: the planet edge smears outward into a hazy streaked halo with no crisp rim and a ghost edge inside it
issues.fix: render the limb sharp, then add a smooth atmosphere falloff on its own layer

issues.where: upper storm vortex, top centre (crops F, J, K)
issues.what: the spiral at the top looks like a swirl filter pasted onto the surface, with flat concentric rings and soft, plastic shading that does not match the clouds around it
issues.fix: build the vortex into the cloud texture with matching detail and lighting

issues.where: lightning on the lower night side (crops I, Q)
issues.what: the violet lightning flashes are small, flat sprites with no glow lighting the nearby cloud
issues.fix: add a soft local glow that lights the surrounding cloud tops

issues.where: upper left and left limb (crops B, D, K, P)
issues.what: the atmosphere glow is a uniform, airbrushed bloom that slightly washes out the limb cloud detail
issues.fix: tighten the bloom and let the glow fade with height above the limb

issues.where: swirl at the top of the globe (crop L)
issues.what: the spiral is very regular and sits slightly apart from the surrounding cloud flow, which hints at a stamped pattern
issues.fix: break up the symmetry of the spiral and blend its arms into the nearby bands

issues.where: right-center vortex and surrounding bands (image-14.png crop A, image-15.png crop K)
issues.what: the spiral vortex stretches and blurs the surface texture into mushy concentric rings with stepped, comb-like pixel artifacts along the bright yellow streaks
issues.fix: replace the procedural swirl warp with high-resolution volumetric or multi-layered cloud maps that preserve crisp detail without UV stretching or pixel stepping

issues.where: central and upper-left illuminated globe surface (image-14.png crops B, F, I, image-15.png crops J, O)
issues.what: crunchy rock-like embossed bumpiness and parallel diagonal corduroy striping sit next to glossy, plastic-looking yellow specular blobs, giving away a displaced 3D heightmap and normal shader
issues.fix: use soft subsurface-scattering cloud shading instead of hard specular and normal-mapped relief, and eliminate high-frequency procedural displacement aliasing

issues.where: planet limb, especially the dark lower and right edges (image-14.png crops D, H, I, image-15.png crops N, P, image-16.png crops S, T, U)
issues.what: a detached bright tan rim line with a darker inner trough outlines even the unlit hemisphere, creating a doubled edge around the sphere
issues.fix: remove the uniform Fresnel rim shell on the nightside and tie atmospheric limb scattering smoothly to the sun direction and terminator

issues.where: atmospheric halo around the limb (image-14.png crops C, D, H, I, image-15.png crops K, N, P, image-16.png crops S, T, U)
issues.what: sharp background stars shine undimmed through the glowing atmospheric haze right up to the hard edge of the planet disc
issues.fix: attenuate and occlude background stars according to the optical depth and brightness of the atmosphere layer

issues.where: lower dark hemisphere near the bottom limb (image-14.png crop D, image-16.png crop T)
issues.what: the dark surface texture becomes soft, smeared, and stretched parallel to the grazing limb
issues.fix: maintain even texel density at grazing angles and near the poles using seamless spherical or triplanar mapping

issues.where: solar glare and upper-right horizon haze (image-10.png crop C, image-11.png crops K, L, M)
issues.what: pinpoint stars remain visible directly inside the bright solar bloom and sunlit atmospheric haze, and a horizontal flare streak forms a faint secondary band just above the limb
issues.fix: mask out stars where solar bloom and bright atmospheric scattering wash out the sky, and soften the horizontal flare streak near the horizon

issues.where: bottom foreground clouds (image-10.png crops D, I, image-12.png crops T, V, W, X)
issues.what: the nearest cloud tops along the bottom margin are noticeably softer and directionally smeared compared with the crisp mid-ground cloud towers
issues.fix: preserve sharp cloud detail in the foreground to match the mid-ground resolution
